- [S63] Atlas Earth-process teaching design study, docs/48-inside-the-earth-content-spec.md §§0–3.5. Independent scales: 91 logical parts, 27 poses, background plus seven chapters and 36 beats. Approximate Earth sphere: R=6371 km; inner-core radius 1221 km; outer-core outer radius 3485 km; uniform 30 km land-crust example; mantle outer radius 6341 km. Derived shell thicknesses: outer core 2264 km, mantle 2856 km, crust 30 km; radii divided by 6371 without prior rounding. The local plate sample enlarges layers; boundary displacement/time, ash grains, fault deformation and structure lean are illustrative. Generic structure: four drawn floors; ground/foundation offset ±0.02 scene units and connected superstructure lean ±1 degree, not an HDB design or structural solution. Wave snapshots (SIM-W): x=0,0.5,…,8 in two 17-marker rows; A=0.08 scene units, f=1/model second, cP=4 and cS=2 diagram units/model second. k=0…8, t=0.25k, τ=t−x/c; u=0 outside 0≤τ≤1/f, otherwise u=A sin(2πfτ). P offset=(u,0,0), S offset=(0,u,0); inspected wave front=c*t. Scene x scale 0.4 is layout only; du is not metre. Both rows share each instant and are separate wave-type comparisons; their offsets are not added. Water symbols (SIM-S): j=−8…8, A=0.12, q=0…8, d=0.5(q−1), K(v)=max(0,1−|v|); for source on and q≥1, η(j)=A/2 [K(j−d)+K(j+d)−K(j−1−d)−K(j+1+d)], glyph offset=(0,η,0). Bed centre rises 0.06, neighbours fall 0.03 scene units and retain the offset. At q0 or source off all offsets are zero; each snapshot Ση=0 (symbol balance only). q is a diagram step, not seconds; changing depth leaves these snapshots unchanged. The shore shape is separate and qualitative. Long-wave speeds (SIM-T): c=√(9.8h) m/s and c×3.6 km/h. At design depths h=100/1000/4000 m, unrounded c=31.304951684997/98.994949366117/197.989898732233 and km/h=112.697826065989/356.381817718020/712.763635436040. Display one decimal: 31.3/99.0/198.0 m/s and 112.7/356.4/712.8 km/h; prose rounds to about 113/356/713 km/h. Source off still returns theoretical speed if a wave is present. Six defaults: wave-kind=p, wave-step=0, water-depth=4000, sea-step=0, sea-uplift=true, flow-mode=none. Tables have 18 wave, 18 displacement and 3 depth rows; output shapes bind to precomputed zero-duration poses. Flows: magma-path count120/speed0.15 and lava-path count80/speed0.08 are visibility choices, not rates of magma transport. / Atlas 地球过程教学设计研究，依据 docs/48-inside-the-earth-content-spec.md 第 0–3.5 节。各小样独立尺度：91 个逻辑零件、27 个姿态、背景加七章共 36 拍。近似地球：半径 6371 千米，内核半径 1221 千米，外核外界半径 3485 千米；采用均匀 30 千米陆壳示例，地幔外半径 6341 千米。相减得到设计厚度：外核 2264、地幔 2856、地壳 30 千米；比例由原数除 6371，不先舍入。岩石圈小样放大层厚，边界位移与时间、灰粒、断层变形及建筑倾斜均为示意。通用结构绘四层楼板；地面／基础偏移 ±0.02 场景单位，上部相连结构倾斜 ±1 度；并非组屋设计或结构求解。SIM-W 波快照：两排各 17 个标记，逻辑 x=0、0.5…8；A=0.08 场景单位、f=每模型秒 1 周、cP=4、cS=2 图解单位每模型秒。k=0…8，t=0.25k，τ=t−x/c；τ 不在 [0,1/f] 内时 u=0，否则 u=A sin(2πfτ)。P 偏移 (u,0,0)，S 偏移 (0,u,0)，观察的波前=c*t。场景 x 缩放 0.4 只为排版，du 不是米。两排采用相同模型时刻，是不同波型的比较，不将偏移叠加。SIM-S 水位符号：j=−8…8，A=0.12，q=0…8，d=0.5(q−1)，K(v)=max(0,1−|v|)；源开且 q≥1 时 η(j)=A/2 [K(j−d)+K(j+d)−K(j−1−d)−K(j+1+d)]，符号偏移 (0,η,0)。中央海床升 0.06，两邻区各降 0.03 场景单位并保留错距；q0 或源关时全部偏移为零。每步 Ση=0 只代表符号正负平衡；q 是图解步骤而非秒，水深不改变快照；近岸形状另作定性示意。SIM-T 长波速度：c=√(9.8h) 米每秒，乘 3.6 换算千米每小时。设计水深 h=100／1000／4000 米，未舍入速度分别为 31.304951684997／98.994949366117／197.989898732233 米每秒，或每小时 112.697826065989／356.381817718020／712.763635436040 千米。显示一位小数：31.3／99.0／198.0 与 112.7／356.4／712.8；正文约为每小时 113／356／713 千米。源关时仍给出存在长波时的理论速度。六默认控件：wave-kind=p、wave-step=0、water-depth=4000、sea-step=0、sea-uplift=true、flow-mode=none。波表 18 行、位移表 18 行、水深表 3 行；形状输出绑定离线生成的零时长姿态。岩浆流 count120／speed0.15、熔岩流 count80／speed0.08 只是可读性设计，不是物质真实输送速率。 (Not measured. Finite snapshots are generated offline from the stated formulas, with scientific basis S15/S60 and Earth dimensions S58/S59; mantle state follows S6. The model does not calculate real arrival times, inundation, wave height, water velocity/pressure/energy, building safety or eruptions. No prediction or diagnosis. Internal double precision is retained; displayed values are rounded only afterwards. All geometry, cameras and motion exaggerations are design choices. / 非实测；按所述公式离线生成有限快照，科学依据为 S15／S60，地球尺寸依据 S58／S59，地幔物态依据 S6。不计算真实到时、淹没、波高、水流速度／压力／能量、建筑安全或喷发；不作预测或诊断。内部保留双精度，最后才对显示值舍入。几何、镜头与运动放大均为设计选择。) (design study / 设计研究)

## Access, narrowing and omissions / 访问限制与删减

- S5 direct access returns 403; only public indexed text is used, with S45 full-text corroboration. S9 direct access showed robot verification at construction recheck; no gate was crossed. Public indexed original page text provided the water-assisted melting paragraph. These access limits are not represented as successful direct full-page reads.
- BCA S23 was read live, including its 2026-10-23 footer update. The lesson attributes the distant-tremor design statement and the two indoor actions to BCA, links the complete guidance, and makes no absolute guarantee or building-code claim.
- S59's molten-mantle simplification is not adopted. S6 supports a mostly solid mantle that deforms over long times. Values from NASA pages form teaching geometry, not one seismic reference model.
- Parent F23 volcano-form taxonomy, F28 energy multiplier, F46 unavailable BC3 checks, F47 regional tsunami risk/barriers and FIE07 continuous-load-path/code claims are cut. S24 (404), S61 (403), S62 (index only) and S52 (403, replaced by S65) are not listed as verified adopted sources. No historical death totals, hazard rankings or unverified MOE page quotations appear.
- The absent `plates-and-hazards` sibling has no link. Its future geographical scope is described in complete prose; add topic-level links only after its actual route exists. Existing `states-of-matter`, `forces`, `energy-conversion` and `materials` routes were checked as published.
- 中文采用规格的编辑译名与 S44／S45 的简体用例；不称为“新加坡标准译名”。不引入未核地区专名、爬高或“弹性回跳”。

The existing choice schema reserves `on`/`off`, so the spec’s `flow-mode: off` serializes as `flow-mode: none` with the same off-state meaning. Existing bindings use `up` and `surface`; no new engine field is added.

现有 choice schema 保留 on／off，因此规格的 flow-mode: off 写为 flow-mode: none，仍表示关闭流动示意。绑定继续采用 up 与 surface，不增加引擎字段。
